note: Closed set. A PageSpec node may only use a pattern listed in its section contract motion.allowedPatterns; liveOnlyNotReproduced entries are NOT allowed in PageSpecs.

none.description: Static. Default for every section: the live site has no scroll-reveal animations (MutationObserver-verified on the homepage).

hero-word-blur-in.description: Per-word blur-in of the h1, then subtitle and actions fade-in on page load.

video-segment-tabs.description: One looping product video split into 16s segments; the active tab follows the video; a 2px progress bar scales per video frame; video fades in over 300ms when playing; plays at intersection >= .12, pauses <= .02.

auto-advance-tabs.description: Tabs advance every 6000ms while the section intersects the viewport; progress recomputed every 50ms (width transition 150ms linear); active image crossfades over 300ms standard easing; click selects and restarts the cycle; leaving the viewport pauses and keeps progress.
auto-advance-tabs.reducedMotionNote: Policy, not a measurement: the clone does not special-case reduced motion for these tabs; generated pages must not auto-advance under prefers-reduced-motion.

accordion-expand.description: Accordion body expands via grid-rows 0fr->1fr over 300ms ease-out (FAQ) or 400ms standard easing (feature accordion).

card-hover-scale.description: Card scales to 1.01 (store cards 1.05) on hover over 300ms standard easing.
card-hover-scale.reducedMotionNote: Policy: keep hover colour change, drop the scale.

color-transition.description: Background/text colour transition on hover/active: 150ms (buttons, links, nav pills) or 200ms (tabs), standard easing.

menu-fade-slide.description: Mega-menu panel fades in and slides from translateY(-8px) over 220ms with a rgba(9,11,11,.3) overlay fading in 220ms; switching triggers swaps content with opacity + translateX(16px) over ~230ms.

sticky-reveal.description: Footer wordmark sits sticky at the bottom under the rounded footer block and is uncovered as the page ends. Pure CSS, no animation.

logo-marquee.description: Infinite linear horizontal logo marquee (default 40s), paused on hover. In the clone this runs only on the sales contact page.

liveOnlyNotReproduced.description: Desktop logo cross-fade/cycling (~3s) on self-hosted logo strips.
Mobile logo strips marquee on feature, solution, plan and comparison pages.
Animated digit transitions on pricing amounts when switching billing period.
Sliding pill behind the active segmented tab.
